(()=>{const h=document.querySelector('.web-page-head'); if(!h||!h.offsetParent) return 'no head'; const hb=h.getBoundingClientRect().bottom; const panels=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.panel, .web-section, .card-group, .settings-list, .home-hero')).filter(e=>e.offsetParent && e!==h && !h.contains(e)).map(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect()).filter(r=>r.height>20).sort((a,b)=>a.top-b.top); const first=panels[0]; const tops=[...new Set(panels.map(r=>Math.round(r.top)))].slice(0,4); const bots=panels.slice(0,6).map(r=>Math.round(r.bottom)); return 'head->first '+Math.round(first.top-hb)+' | tops '+tops.join(',')+' | bottoms '+bots.join(',')})()
